name: smwgraphics-super-mario-all-stars-super-mario-bros-lakitu
title: Super Mario All-Stars: Super Mario Bros. - Lakitu
description:
Made for C3 Summer 2022.

This graphic includes the SMAS-SMB Sprite graphic for the Custom SMB3 Lakitu Sprite

For the SMAS-SMB1 Spiny graphics, use this.


If you want to get the right the Lakitu sprite palette to be the same as the one from the original game then change the following:

lakitu_smb3.cfg and lakitu_smb3_boss.cfg files in CFG Editor to Pal D.

For the cloud title go to lakitu_smb3.asm file and get to ;Cloud palette.

Now change the !CloudPal = $02 to $0B and your good to go.
